entities.name: Abortion of RRC connection establishment
entities.description: Procedure triggered when upper layers abort RRC connection establishment due to NAS procedure abortion before UE enters RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: Timer T300
entities.description: Timer used during RRC connection establishment procedure.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has established connection with network.

entities.name: Upper layers abort RRC connection establishment
entities.description: Condition where upper layers abort RRC connection establishment due to NAS procedure being aborted.

entities.name: Stop timer T300
entities.description: Action to stop timer T300 if it is running.

entities.name: Reset MAC
entities.description: Action to reset MAC layer configuration.

entities.name: Release MAC configuration
entities.description: Action to release MAC layer configuration.

entities.name: Re-establish RLC for all RBs
entities.description: Action to re-establish RLC for all established radio bearers.

relations.description: Upper layer abort condition triggers the RRC connection establishment abortion procedure.
The abortion procedure includes stopping timer T300 if running.
The abortion procedure includes resetting MAC layer.
The abortion procedure includes releasing MAC configuration.
The abortion procedure includes re-establishing RLC for all established radio bearers.
The abort condition applies only when UE has not yet entered RRC_CONNECTED state.
